## Description

Start/stop only for the verified current encounter with consent; device-bound session start with nonce; LED on throughout capture (firmware-enforced); chunks uploaded via phone relay or Wi-Fi with integrity hashes; never attachable to two encounters.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The clip cannot record without an active encounter + consent authorisation (server and firmware).
- [ ] **AC2.** LED is on whenever the microphone captures (hardware test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Replayed or out-of-sequence chunks are rejected.
- [ ] **AC4.** Device, consent and overlap test suites pass (exit gate 1).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
